resources.string: Screen recording

Recording continues within the scope you choose in Android permission. Seeking, navigation, dialogs and other interactions do not stop recording. Pages, text you enter, controls, notifications and other visible information within that scope may appear. During private recording, capture protection is temporarily lifted for the relevant ESV windows; other capture apps may also see them. Protected content may be black and some playback sound may be unavailable. Stop and save or Discard ends the session; system interruption or resource limits can also end it.
Waiting for Android permission. Recording has not started. Return here and tap Continue.
Review the visible page again. Permission alone does not start recording. Continue only when the page and selected sound are ready.
Preparing the approved recording. Screen protection is managed by the recording owner.
Recording continues across normal interactions. Stop and save preserves a valid result only after verification and publication.

On Android 12 / 12L, recording may leave a page thumbnail in Recents. ESV cannot guarantee deletion of thumbnails already saved by Android.

Current engineering limits: up to 2 hours and 2 GiB per recording, with a storage safety reserve and at least 64 MiB free. Preparation and finalization each have a 15-second budget. Explicit recording pauses are limited to 10 minutes and 32 resumed boundaries. These are limits, not measured capacity guarantees; webpage play, pause and seeking are separate.

Verification checks sample structure and decodes first, middle, final and resumed keyframe groups. The 60-second verification budget may reject a long recording; not every frame is decoded. Device and real-permission acceptance remains separate.

Native recording resources have not confirmed release. New recording is blocked. End the app through Android and reopen it to recover; recording will not restart automatically. A completed save task alone does not confirm capture cleanup.
